title.official: When no defence is filed in foreclosure action

division.heading: Actions Started by Statement of Claim

operative_text.controlling:
3.41(1)  If a defendant in a foreclosure action does not file a
statement of defence or demand for notice, the plaintiff must note
the defendant in default before filing an application for
(a) personal judgment, or
(b) a remedy referred to in rule 6.5(2).
(2)  A defendant may be noted in default even if the defendant has
filed and served a notice of address for service.

BOOK_A.commentary_review_flag: Read in full, p.3-110 (lines 3084-3089): rule text, Information Note, Defined Terms 'defendant, file, foreclosure action, judgment, plaintiff, remedy' (the Appendix defines 'foreclosure action', line 40762, and 'remedy', line 41059), Related Provisions; no note of its own. The built record: the information note (Book A only), defined_terms and related_provisions; related_provisions ends with the title of 3.42 ('Limitation on When Judgment or Noting in Default May Occur'); commentary is empty; nothing dropped. The history footnote 1 (1996 R.686(6), (7), first enacted by Alta.Reg.3/96) and footnote 2 (Gauthier v. Starr 2016 ABQB 213, 86 CPC(7th) 348 (¶ 13)) print before the rule text and are in the built 3.40 record; the marker '1' follows 3.41(2) and the marker '2' is not printed in this record. (1) Information Note: 'In foreclosure actions a notice of address for service may be filed and served under rule 11.24 [Notice of address for service in foreclosure actions]' - agrees with official 11.24 (title matches) and with 3.41(2). (2) Related Provisions read against the official titles: '3.77 (subsequent encumbrancers)' (official 'Subsequent encumbrancers not parties in foreclosure action'); '6.6 (application in foreclosure action)' - official 6.6 is 'Response and reply to application', and 6.6(1)-(3) (respondent's affidavit, applicant's response, costs) is not limited to foreclosure actions, so the label does not match the title; '9.30 (foreclosure generally)' - official 9.30 is 'When affidavit of value must be filed' (an affidavit of value before an application for a redemption order or an order that secured property be offered for sale); '11.23 (address for service)' - official 11.23 is 'Additional service options in foreclosure actions' (the notice of address for service is 11.24, which the information note cites correctly). The rule text's own label '6.5(2) [Notice of an application in foreclosure actions]' differs from the official title 'Notice of application in foreclosure action'. (3) Other rules' pointers to 3.41: Book A p.3-246 (lines 8096-8097; the rule those lines belong to was not identified) '3.41 (no defence in foreclosure); 6.5 (notice in foreclosure actions)'; R.6 p.6-57 (line 2995) '3.41 (noting in default in foreclosure)'; R.9 p.9-74 (line 3842) '3.41 (default of defence in foreclosure)'; R.11 p.11-30 (line 1359) 'rule 3.41 [When no defence is filed in a foreclosure action]' (adds 'a' to the official title, like the 3.38 text); the official 3.38 ('Subject to rule 3.41') cites it. (4) TLA Food Services 2011 ABQB 550 para 47 (Book B, 3.38 commentary) quotes the start of 3.41(1) ('If a defendant in a foreclosure action does not file a statement of defence or demand for notice, the plaintiff must note the defendant in default before filing an application for ...'), which agrees with the official 3.41(1).
